fit: date-fruit constituents in computational cancer-pathway analysis
assessment: The complete IGMC member P105 analyzes targets predicted for named date-fruit constituents. It provides no administered product, primary pain measurement or Parkinson comparison. The supplement identifier includes many unrelated abstracts.

fit: Sewy date-seed extracts and inflammatory markers in rat arthritis
assessment: The original abstract reports reduced swelling and inflammatory markers in a rat model under polar or nonpolar seed extracts. The body and any separate pain test remain open. The customary use description has no firsthand patient outcome.
